text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: sudden tail-latency spike on streaming.generate. p95 jumped ~220ms -> ~1.6s, p99 from ~600ms -> ~4.9s. Several clients reported aborted streams/timeouts. Alert fired 2026-06-12T01:04:49Z.

maya: looks correlated with prefix-hash rollout (hash-v4) that went out ~00:42 UTC. routing-kv hit_rate collapsed.

liam: digging traces now. Paging layer shows per-page fetch lat moving from median 30ms -> 240ms. Lots of re-fetches when KV prefixes miss.

priya: field reports: 3 customers reported degraded streaming, one escalated to support call. No data corruption, mostly UX latency/regressions.

sam: deploy-bot shows: prefix-hash:v4 rolled 00:42->00:46 (20% -> 100%). Also saw cache.shard_count bump 64 -> 80 in same window.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics flagged eviction churn but rollout continued; no automated rollback triggered.

liam: quick histogram diff: hash_v4 redistributes keys, clustering increased on shards 12-14. Hot-shard eviction rate up 6x. That explains local hot eviction storms and low global hit rate.

maya: mitigation options: 1) pause/rollback hash-v4 2) steer critical routes to fallback routing tier/region 3) warm top prefixes aggressively 4) temporarily increase in-memory cache capacity.

priya: drafting customer comms: "We are aware of increased latency on streaming endpoints. We're routing affected traffic to a fallback while we stabilize. We'll post updates every 30m."

ops-rotation: taking handoff for oncall. Maya you remain for rollback ops, Liam owns trace/analysis, Sam do routing toggles & rollback, Priya handle comms.

liam: running curl/trace against page backend and capturing flame/strace. dropping a collector snippet in #tmp so others can copy.

sam: initiating rollback of hash-v4 at 01:16 UTC and toggling 25% of traffic to fallback region-1. Rolling back shard_count change as part of the same action.

maya: rollback started; cache will rebuild. Watching kvprefix.hit_rate and page latencies.

monitor-bot: metric snapshot 01:20 UTC: streaming.generate p95=420ms, p99=1.1s, page.fetch.p95=85ms, kvprefix.hit_rate=0.64.

priya: update sent; one affected customer confirmed improvement after rollback.

ops-rotation: keep monitoring 60m. If p99 > 1.5s persist, escalate to capacity bump + longer rollback window. All mitigation actions logged.

maya: preliminary root cause: hash_v4 distribution + shard_count change produced uneven key distribution -> concentrated evictions -> cache miss storm -> paging backpressure -> streaming stalls. Action items: revert hash and shard_count (done), add distrib unit test for hash functions, enhance canary gating to include per-shard eviction and hit-rate thresholds, implement automatic fallback trigger when hit_rate < 0.3 for 5m, and prepare a customer-facing postmortem.

liam: saving traces/logs to /opt/incidents/1803456789 and archiving sampling for postmortem analysis.

sam: immediate mitigation complete: rollback applied, fallback routing in place. Please confirm stability before clearing alerts.

ops-rotation: marking incident as mitigated for now; keeping incident open for follow-up and postmortem.
_note: This thread reproduces a Slack incident coordination channel. Messages are chronological and prefixed with sender names. Timestamps are in the metadata fields.
